tiles: Airships, domes, and golden hour atmosphere
Generative layouts refined for architectural clarity
challenge: Creating a steampunk cityscape series that balances ornate Victorian architecture with visible mechanical systems. The goal was to render intricate gear work, domed structures, and airships within cohesive compositions that feel both elegant and industrial, all bathed in warm golden-hour light.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate city grid layouts with strong verticals and layered mechanical motifs. In-painting refined edge integrity around intricate gear and dome details, while Lightroom established the warm, cinematic light pacing and focal hierarchy across each panel.
result: Delivered a six-piece steampunk cityscape collection with consistent architectural detail and atmospheric warmth. The panels hold up at both thumbnail scale for portfolio grids and at full resolution for large-format art prints and exhibition display.
